name: std::expected<T,E>::operator->, std::expected<T,E>::operator*
intro:
Accesses the expected value contained in *this.

1,2) Returns a pointer to the expected value.

3-6) Returns a reference to the expected value.

7) Returns nothing.

If has_value() is false, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: These operators do not check whether the optional represents an expected value! You can do so manually by using has_value() or simply operator bool(). Alternatively, if checked access is needed, value() or value_or() may be used.

summary: Accesses the expected value contained in *this.
